Date: 02/06/2026

## GOHREP
**Goal:**

View the CDA bounding boxes on top of the source agroinfiltration images, to check
the collected annotations.

**Hypothesis:**

Some annotations will be wrong, and they need to be found by eye.

### 1. Import required packages
Use 'cda' mode to step through one CDA at a time, or 'raw' mode to see all the
CDAs in one agroinfiltration image. Press the space bar to save the current view
as a JPEG. The viewer needs the lab network drive. The Tkinter window closes when
the interactive session closes, which is expected.
```{python}
# 1
from pathlib import Path

repo_root = next(p for p in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents] if (p / '.git').exists())
from annotation_viewer import view_annotations
```

### 2. View Set 1 — one CDA at a time
```{python}
# 2
view_annotations(
    data_path=repo_root / "analyses/01_generate_raw_data/02_combining_cdascorer_outputs/combined_cda_data_1.csv",
    raw_folder_path="/Volumes/shared/Research-Groups/Mark-Banfield/Josh_Williams/Scoring_5May",
    mode='cda',
    starting_row=0,
)
```

### 3. View Set 2 — one full image at a time
```{python}
# 3
view_annotations(
    data_path=repo_root / "analyses/01_generate_raw_data/02_combining_cdascorer_outputs/combined_cda_data_2.csv",
    raw_folder_path="/Volumes/shared/Research-Groups/Mark-Banfield/Josh_Williams/Scoring_20Oct",
    mode='raw',
    starting_row=0,
)
```
